name: Investigate Echo Ridge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
narrative.offerRewardText: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 1 to 5, 1,140 XP in all.

quests.name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Investigate Echo Ridge
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Report to Goldshire
quests.objectiveText: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
